answer: Require each agent identity to anchor a refundable stake plus a verifiable compute receipt: registration locks tokens and publishes a proof-of-work certificate tied to unique hardware. An attacker crossing that canyon of cost must rebuy stake and hardware for every fake identity, instead of spawning thousands free across an empty tundra of throwaway accounts. The stake is slashed if one hardware key certifies twice, so each sybil costs real money while honest agents pay once and operate freely.
